title: Re-Volt/Championships
text:
There are four cups in Championship mode that you must win in order to unlock certain cars and new tracks. Each championship has eight cars maximum participating, and each position awards certain number of points. First place awards ten points, second place awards six points, third place awards four points, fourth place awards three points, fifth place awards two points, sixth place awards one point, seventh and eighth place award no points at all. It's possible to win Championship mode by finishing in second or third, but no cars or tracks will be unlocked and Progress Table won't change.

Championship mode has feature similar to video games's extra lives, which is called Try. Each championship has three tries available for you with option to use a try to restart race if needed by choosing Give Up Try option. One try is automatically used if you end one stage of championship either at fourth place or lower. If you fail to finish either at third place or higher and you have no more tries remaining, you will lose championship, and game will end.

After championship ends, cutscene is shown where first three places (of points table) are positioned in Frontend Podium where they jump to celebrate their victory. If you finish championship either in fourth place or lower, you car will be placed upside-down beside the podium with Bomb Power-Up activated, then it will explode, sent off onto floor, and destroyed.

Championship 1: Bronze Cup
thumb|Championship 1 screenshot
 Name: Bronze Cup
 Tracks: 4
 Difficulty: Easy

First championship is called Bronze Cup and it's of easy difficulty. Cars you will race against in Bronze Cup are all Rookie rating which are RC Bandit, Dust Mite, Phat Slug, Col Moss, Harvester, Dr. Grudge, Volken Turbo, and Sprinter XL, with one of them being replaced with car of your choice if you choose car of higher rating. First track in Bronze Cup is Normal version of Toys in the Hood 1 with three laps. Second track in Bronze Cup is Normal version of SuperMarket 2 with four laps. Third track in Bronze Cup is Normal version of Museum 2 with three laps. Fourth and final track in Bronze Cup is Normal version of Botanical Garden with five laps.

Championship 2: Silver Cup
thumb|Championship 2 screenshot
 Name: Silver Cup
 Tracks: 4
 Difficulty: Medium

Second championship is called Silver Cup and it's of medium difficulty. Cars you will race against in Silver Cup are Amateur rating which are RC San, Candy Pebbles, Genghis Kar, Aquasonic, and Mouse, as well as Advanced rating which are Evil Weasel, Panga TC, R6 Turbo, NY 54, and Bertha Ballistics, with one of them being replaced with car of your choice if you choose car of lower or higher rating. First track in Silver Cup is Normal version of Toy World 1 with six laps. Second track in Silver Cup is Mirrored version of Toys in the Hood 1 with four laps. Third track in Silver Cup is Normal version of Ghost Town 1 with four laps. Fourth and final track in Silver Cup is Normal version of Toy World 2 with four laps.

Championship 3: Gold Cup
thumb|Championship 3 screenshot
 Name: Gold Cup
 Tracks: 4
 Difficulty: Hard

Third championship is called Gold Cup and it's of hard difficulty. Cars you will race against in Gold Cup are Advanced rating which are Evil Weasel, Panga TC, R6 Turbo, NY 54, and Bertha Ballistics, as well as Semi-Pro rating which are Pest Control, Adeon, Pole Poz, and Zipper while Rotor is unable to be selected as opponent at all, with one of them being replaced with car of your choice if you choose car of lower or higher rating. First track in Gold Cup is Normal version of Toys in the Hood 2 with five laps. Second track in Gold Cup is Mirrored version of Toy World 1 with eight laps. Third track in Gold Cup is Normal version of Toytanic 1 with five laps. Fourth and final track in Gold Cup is Normal version of Museum 1 with five laps.

Championship 4: Platinum Cup
thumb|Championship 4 screenshot
 Name: Platinum Cup
 Tracks: 5
 Difficulty: Extreme

Fourth and final championship is called Platinum Cup and it's insane. Cars you will race against in Gold Cup are Advanced rating which are Evil Weasel, Panga TC, R6 Turbo, NY 54, and Bertha Ballistics, Semi-Pro rating which are Pest Control, Adeon, Pole Poz, and Zipper while Rotor is unable to be selected as opponent at all, as well as Pro rating which are Cougar, Humma, Toyeca, and AMW while Panga is unable to be selected as opponent at all, with one of them being replaced with car of your choice if you choose car of lower rating. First track in Platinum Cup is Normal version of SuperMarket 1 with six laps. Second track in Platinum Cup is Normal version of Ghost Town with six laps. Third track in Platinum Cup is Reversed version of Toy World 1 with ten laps. Fourth track in Platinum Cup is Mirrored version of Museum 1 with six laps. Fifth and final track in Platinum Cup is Normal version of Toytanic 2 with six laps. Fourth championship is also final championship of the game overall, if you win it, you will unlock all tracks and be crowned as Re-Volt Master.
